There is no time to lose for SIDS in accelerating their sustainable energy revolution.
 
2024 was a critical year for SIDS to establish a pathway for the next decade of development, as the Antigua and Barbuda Agenda for SIDS placed sustainable energy at the center of SIDS' new development pathway.
 
But, 2025 is the year for action.
 
Explore this new policy paper on how SIDS can scale equitable policy, transformative finance, technology transfer, and strategic partnerships 👉🏼 go.undp.org/34Q

SIDS have seen a 150% growth in renewable capacity between 2014 to 2023, from 3.4 to 8.7 GW. Yet, acceleration in finance and integrated policy is required to see the transformative potential for whole-of-island development. To reach SIDS’ ambitious 100% renewable targets for 2030, urgent and strategic actions are needed to scale impact on the ground.
 
Join us, in Rising Up For SIDS to support them in leading their sustainabel energy revolution.
